archetype: Swiss & High-Contrast mixed with Jewel & Luxury (Premium Dark Mode SaaS)

structure.app_container: h-screen w-full flex overflow-hidden bg-[#09090b] text-[#fafafa]
structure.sidebar: w-64 flex-shrink-0 border-r border-[#27272a] bg-[#18181b] flex flex-col
structure.right_panel: w-72 flex-shrink-0 border-l border-[#27272a] bg-[#18181b]/50 hidden lg:flex flex-col

components.buttons: Shadcn UI Buttons, customized with primary accent color and crisp edges (rounded-md). Include hover states (lighter hue) and focus rings (ring-2 ring-primary/50).
components.inputs: Shadcn UI Inputs, bg-zinc-900 border-zinc-800 focus:border-indigo-500 focus:ring-1 focus:ring-indigo-500 rounded-md.
components.chat_message: Optical alignment with avatar on left. Generous line height. Hover state slightly highlights the message row (bg-zinc-800/30). Group consecutive messages from the same user (hide avatar/name on subsequent messages within 5 mins).
components.presence_indicator: Absolute positioned bottom-right of avatar, circular, 3px border matching parent background to cut out the avatar.
components.scrollbars: Custom thin scrollbars, dark thumb, no gutter.
components.modals_dialogs: Shadcn Dialog with Glassmorphism overlay (backdrop-blur-sm bg-black/60). Dialog body solid bg-zinc-950 border border-zinc-800.

motion.message_entrance: Framer motion staggered fade-up for new messages (y: 10, opacity: 0 -> y: 0, opacity: 1, duration: 0.2s)
motion.typing_indicator: 3-dot bouncing animation using framer-motion (staggerChildren, repeat: Infinity)

login_background.description: Abstract glowing crosses against dark background

accessibility_and_testing.data_testid_rule: ALL interactive elements MUST include a data-testid attribute (e.g., data-testid='login-submit-button', data-testid='message-input')
accessibility_and_testing.contrast: Ensure minimum 4.5:1 ratio for text. Use APCA guidelines.
accessibility_and_testing.focus: Clear focus rings on keyboard navigation.

instructions_to_main_agent: Use Framer Motion for message appearances and typing indicators.
Build Shadcn components using Javascript (no Typescript).
Ensure dark mode is default by applying `dark` class to HTML or root element.
Implement the 3-column layout strictly: Sidebar (Channels/DMs), Main View (Chat), Right Sidebar (Thread/Profile details).
Don't use raw generic placeholder images, ONLY use the URLs provided in this JSON.
Apply `Outfit` font for brand and headers, `Inter` for regular text. Add to Tailwind config and import from Google Fonts.
Use React Hot Toast for all app notifications.
Include empty states for unselected chats and search results using minimalist layouts, potentially with the abstract background image lightly overlaid.
